Vibe Widget - Full Docs Index
Notebook widgets generated from a prompt and your data.

Install:
- pip install vibe-widget

Security model:
- A widget runs model-generated JavaScript in the notebook page, with the privileges that page has. Read the code before you trust a result, and use approve mode when you want to see it first.

Pages:
- /docs: Installation - Install the package, set one API key, and create a first widget.
- /docs/config: Configuration - Set the model, the endpoint, and the safety limits.
- /docs/create: Create - Generate a widget from a prompt and a dataset.
- /docs/edit: Edit - Change a generated widget with a follow-up prompt, in Python or in the widget itself.
- /docs/audit: Audit - Ask a second model call to review a generated widget and report what it finds.
- /docs/reactivity: Reactivity - Send values into a widget, read values back out, and link widgets together.
- /docs/composability: Load & Save - Store widgets on disk, share them through git, and reload them later.
- /docs/theming: Theming - Describe how a widget should look, and reuse that description across widgets.

Docs export:
- /docs.txt
- /docs-export.json

Changelog:
- https://github.com/dwootton/vibe-widget/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
